digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler live verification against Jira Data Center
propositions: The reconciler must prove bidirectional data movement against a realistic store copy, not an empty instance, by creating a separate isolated git repo with no remotes, copying the production tickets branch, and scrubbing all .bridge_state* artifacts and Jira bindings to prevent unintended production writes.

The scrubbed store copy must be verified as complete and properly isolated: the ticket count on the copy must match the fetched branch, zero git remotes must exist on both the outer repo and the inner .tickets-tracker/ repo, and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off must be enforced.

All fourteen inbound mutation types (create, edit summary/description/status/labels/comments, assign, unassign, create/delete links, set/clear parent, delete) must round-trip from DC to local store and each must be asserted individually against a named oracle, with the exception that set_parent's epic case raises NotImplementedError and is asserted directly against the transport.

All fourteen corresponding outbound mutation types must round-trip from local store to DC with individual oracles, scoped to single tickets via --filter-local-ids to prevent spurious mass creation, and UPDATE mutations require binding establishment via a priming pass to avoid regressing to CREATE.
A repeated pass after each mutation direction must write nothing (idempotence), with index-lag waits before re-planning to distinguish genuine churn from search index lag.

Pagination must be exercised live by observing the effective server page size, seeding at least 2*observed+1 issues to force three pages, and asserting full recovery of all seeded issues in the inbound plan.
